capabilities.description: Ingests the uploaded contract and BOQ, extracts the priced BOQ lines and the contract clause set, and versions them as the authoritative baseline every other capability reads from.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record
document:harbourline_boq.xlsx priced items P1-P5, E1-E5 with unit, quantity and rate

capabilities.description: Builds interim progress claims from measured BOQ quantities against the source-of-record BOQ, values each line at its contract rate, and produces the claim for certification.

Certifies interim payment certificates from approved claims, applies the 5% retention per certificate, and schedules the two retention releases at Taking-Over and at the end of the Defects Notification Period.
requirements: Clause 14.3 Retention: 5% of each Interim Payment Certificate, released 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period
Clause 11.1 Defects Notification Period: 365 days from Taking-Over

capabilities.description: Tracks elapsed days against the 730-day time for completion from the Commencement Date and computes delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day, stopping at the 10% cap.
requirements: Clause 8.2 Time for Completion: 730 days from the Commencement Date
Clause 8.7 Delay Damages: 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount

capabilities.description: Holds inspection and test plan records and QA evidence against BOQ work items, with an evidence chain so each sign-off is traceable to the item it covers.
Maintains the controlled project document register with revision history and issue status, including the as-built documentation item and the performance security submission.
requirements: Clause 4.2 Performance Security: 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount

capabilities.description: Rolls up claim status, certification position, retention held, accrued delay damages against the cap, open ITP items, and register completeness for the project team.
Documentation capability (reused from the block store)
